title: Steady States of Transport-Coagulation-Nucleation Models
summary: To model the dynamics of polymers formed through nucleation, elongated by polymerisation, shortened by depolymerisation and subject to aggregation reactions, we study a nonlinear integro-differential equation. Growth and shrinkage are described by transport terms, nucleation by a positive boundary condition, and aggregation by a Smoluchowski coagulation kernel. Our main result is the existence of steady states for the multiplicative coagulation kernel despite this kernel producing gelation in finite time for the pure coagulation equation.
